release: Digital Research CP/M 3.1, John Elliott Unix build 2026-06-07

ASM.COM.reason: Neither the executable nor matching source is present in the exact pinned CP/M 3 source/binary release. The ISIS ASM80 build tool named upstream is not CP/M ASM.COM.

LOAD.COM.reason: Neither the executable nor matching source is present in the exact pinned CP/M 3 source/binary release. Admitted HEXCOM.COM already converts host-produced Intel HEX without importing an unexplained LOAD binary.

ED.COM.build: Pinned upstream Makefile through original PL/M-80, ASM80, Thames, and ZXCC; the original PL/M tools are deliberately not new default host dependencies.

strict_8080_cosim.workflow: ED EDTEST.TXT; wait for : *; Istring^Z; E; TYPE EDTEST.TXT

SID.COM.build: Byte-identical local rebuild with pinned MAC.COM, RMAC.COM, DRLINK.COM, ZXCC, and the archived assembly sources.

RMAC.COM.reason: The pinned release includes this executable to rebuild CP/M 3 but no matching RMAC source. It remains an audited host-side ZXCC input and cannot enter a target profile under the source-required admission rule.

MAC.COM.reason: The exact binary is required by the upstream build and local SID/HEXCOM/PATCH reproduction, but matching source is absent.

DRLINK.COM.reason: The exact binary is required by the upstream build and local SID reproduction, but matching source is absent.

selected_workflow: Edit source and text with ED.COM.
Build Intel HEX on the modern host with the pinned strict-8080 zmac path.
Convert HELLO.HEX on target with reproducibly rebuilt HEXCOM.COM.
Debug the resulting HELLO.COM with reproducibly rebuilt SID.COM.
Inspect binary patches with reproducibly rebuilt PATCH.COM.
